decisions.quote: This study conducted a conceptual replication examining the reliability, stability, and sensitivity to growth of slopes produced from CBM-W. Eighty-nine (N = 89) eighth-grade students responded to one CBM-W probe weekly for 11 weeks.
decisions.reason: The supplied source text (5e1e14843d69c7cd.txt) consists only of a 4-line title, author line, and abstract for Romig & Olsen (2020) (10.1080/10573569.2020.1860841). Neither prior_adjudication_path nor prior_state_path exists on disk (never adjudicated). While the abstract explicitly states that the study 'conducted a conceptual replication examining the reliability, stability, and sensitivity to growth of slopes produced from CBM-W' with N = 89 eighth-grade students over 11 weeks, it contains no citation, author name, publication year, or title identifying the original study or studies being replicated. Consequently, from the available source text alone, it is impossible to determine whether this target is already captured by shipped row 363 (McMaster, Du, Yeo, Deno, Parker, & Ellis, 2011, 10.1177/001440291107700203, 'Curriculum-Based Measures of Beginning Writing: Technical Features of the Slope') or represents a genuinely missing unshipped paper.
